import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long A = 0, B = 0;
        long k = 0; // initialized to 0 to avoid undefined behavior (original C++ had uninitialized k)
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (i == 1) {
                A = k;
                B = i;
            }
            k = x * i / y;
            for (long j = 0; j <= 10; j++) {
                k += j;
                long mn1 = Math.abs(x * i - y * k) * y * B;
                long mn2 = Math.abs(x * B - y * A) * y * i;
                if (mn1 < mn2) {
                    A = k;
                    B = i;
                }
            }
        }
        long g = gcd(A, B);
        System.out.println((A / g) + "/" + (B / g));
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        a = Math.abs(a);
        b = Math.abs(b);
        while (b != 0) {
            long t = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = t;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
